code.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the person who runs this service if you think that is a mistake.
code.account_exists: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in instead, or use a different address.
code.account_not_verified: Verify your email address first. Use the link we sent you, or ask for a new one at the top of the page.
code.analysis_model_failed: Claude could not produce a usable analysis. Nothing was changed. Try again, and if it keeps failing, try later.
code.analysis_not_confirmed: The values were not confirmed yet. Scan again to start over, then confirm the values before you build the plan.
code.attempt_active: An attempt is already running for this task. Wait for it to finish or interrupt it first.
code.budget_allowance_exhausted: Your free monthly allowance is used up. Add your own API key on the account page, or wait for next month.
code.budget_task_exhausted: This task has used its budget. Create a new task with a larger budget to continue.
code.capability_unavailable: This server does not have that part set up yet.
code.capability_unsatisfied: The chosen model cannot do what this task needs. Pick a different model and try again.
code.destination_blocked: That address is not allowed. Use the public HTTPS address of your provider.
code.email_not_verified: Verify your email address first. Use the link we sent you, or ask for a new one at the top of the page.
code.email_taken: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in instead, or use a different address.
code.evidence_not_approved: The excerpts were not approved on the server. Scan again and approve them to continue.
code.forbidden: Your role on this project does not allow that. Ask the project owner for access.
code.github_already_linked: That GitHub account is already linked to a different account here. Sign in with that account instead.
code.github_bad_response: GitHub answered in a way we did not expect. Try again in a few minutes.
code.github_code_rejected: GitHub did not accept the sign-in. Start again with the GitHub button.
code.github_denied: GitHub sign-in was cancelled. Use the GitHub button to try again, or sign in with your email.
code.github_email_conflict: An account with your GitHub email already exists. Sign in with your email and password, then connect GitHub from your account page.
code.github_email_unavailable: GitHub did not share a verified email address. Make an email public or verified on GitHub, or create an account with your email instead.
code.github_not_configured: GitHub sign-in is not set up on this server. Sign in with your email instead.
code.github_state_mismatch: The GitHub sign-in could not be matched to this browser. Start again with the GitHub button.
code.github_unreachable: GitHub could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
code.grace_period_over: The 30 days for restoring this project have passed, so it can no longer be restored.
code.grant_revoked: The permission for this attempt was revoked, so the agent can no longer act. Start a new attempt if you want to continue.
code.http_413: That is larger than the server accepts. Choose a smaller file or fewer files.
code.http_5xx: The server had a problem. Wait a moment and try again.
code.internal: The server had a problem and may not have saved your change. Reload to check, then try again.
code.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match. Check both and try again, or reset your password.
code.invalid_request: Something you entered was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
code.invalid_token: This link is not valid any more. Links work once and expire, so ask for a new one.
code.keys_unavailable: This server cannot store API keys. The free monthly allowance still works.
code.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
code.no_source: There is no mod in this project yet. Create one, upload one or import one first.
code.not_found: We could not find that. It may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.
code.origin_not_allowed: The server refused this request because it came from a different site. Open HOI4 Factory from its own address and try again.
code.plan_changed: The plan changed since you reviewed it. Reload the plan and review it again.
code.plan_not_approved: The plan is not approved. Review it and approve it first.
code.plan_not_built: No plan has been built yet. Build the plan first.
code.project_busy: Another operation is running on this project. Wait a moment and try again.
code.project_pending_deletion: This project is waiting to be deleted. Restore it first if you want to change it.
code.provider_auth_failed: The model provider did not accept the API key. Check the key, or choose a different one.
code.provider_quota_exhausted: The model provider says this key has no quota left. Check your plan with the provider, or choose a different key.
code.rate_limited_one: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} second and try again.
code.rate_limited_other: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} seconds and try again.
code.recovery_required: An earlier change was not finished. Recover it first (see the recovery section), then try again.
code.required_context_too_large: The mod files this task needs do not fit in the model's context. Narrow the allowed paths or choose a model with a larger context.
code.root_changed: The mod changed on the server after the plan was made, so the plan no longer fits. Scan again to start over.
code.setup_session_expired: Your setup session timed out. Scan the mod again to continue.
code.setup_session_missing: Your setup session ended, for example because the server restarted. Scan the mod again to continue.
code.task_paused: This task is paused. Resume it first.
code.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue.
code.unresolved_effects: An earlier tool action has an unknown outcome. It has to be checked before a new attempt can start.
code.version_conflict: Someone else changed this task. The page was reloaded with the latest state, so check it and try again.

setup.title: Set up the mod
setup.intro: Setup works through a few steps. It scans the mod, asks Claude to suggest values, lets you confirm them, then shows exactly what it would create, change or leave alone. Nothing is written to your mod until the last step, and only after you approve the exact plan shown.

sessionEnded.body: Your setup session ended (the server restarted or it timed out). Scan the mod again to continue.

scan.intro: Setup reads the mod and lists what it found. The scan changes nothing.
scan.againHint: Scanning again starts the steps below over.
scan.done: The scan finished. Nothing needed your attention.
scan.incomplete: The scan stopped early because of a limit, so this picture is incomplete. Treat anything missing as unchecked, not as fine.
scan.unchanged: The scan only reads the mod. Your files were not changed.
scan.changed: The mod changed while it was being scanned. Scan again before you go on.

evidence.intro: To suggest good values, Claude needs to read a few excerpts from your mod. Look through them and keep only the ones you are happy to share.
evidence.thirdParty: The excerpts you approve are sent to a third-party model provider (Anthropic). Excerpts you leave unchecked are not sent.
evidence.truncated: There are more excerpts than are listed here. Only the ones shown can be approved.
evidence.noCandidates: The scan found no excerpts to send. You can continue without any.
evidence.approve_one: Approve this excerpt and send it to the model
evidence.approve_other: Approve these {{count}} excerpts and send them to the model
evidence.noneWarning: You are approving no excerpts. Claude will work from the scan facts and your description only, so its suggestions may be weaker.
evidence.done_one: You approved {{count}} excerpt for the model.
evidence.done_other: You approved {{count}} excerpts for the model.
evidence.doneNone: You approved no excerpts. Claude works from the scan facts only.

analyze.intro: Claude reads the scan and the approved excerpts, then suggests the mod's description, identity and conventions. You confirm or change every value in the next step.
analyze.patience: This may take a minute or two, and sometimes up to three minutes.
analyze.leaveNote: If you leave this page the analysis is not cancelled. You can come back and continue.
analyze.notConfigured: Analysis is not configured on this server, so Setup cannot ask Claude for suggestions. Ask whoever runs this server to set it up.

confirm.intro: Check each value and change what is wrong. Nothing is written to your mod yet. Confirming only records these values for the plan.
confirm.proposalsCaption: Values Claude suggested, with its confidence and reasoning
confirm.componentsNote: These are only recommendations. They are not applied unless the plan lists them.
confirm.author: Author
confirm.rejected: Some values were not accepted. Fix them and confirm again.
confirm.done: Values confirmed. Nothing has been written to the mod yet.

plan.intro: Setup works out every file it would create, change or leave alone. This is a dry run. Nothing is written.
plan.notApproved: This plan is not approved yet.
plan.tableCaption: Files Setup would create, change or leave alone
plan.nothingToChange: Setup has nothing to change in this mod.
plan.conflictsIntro: These files already exist and differ from what Setup wants to write. Setup will not overwrite them without your decision. Choose what to do with each one.
plan.unresolved_one: {{count}} conflict still needs a decision. The plan cannot be approved until it is resolved.
plan.unresolved_other: {{count}} conflicts still need a decision. The plan cannot be approved until they are resolved.
plan.noOptions: Setup offers no automatic choice for this file. Resolve it in the mod itself, then scan again.
plan.decided: Your decisions are saved. Because the plan changed, it now has a new hash ({{hash}}) and any earlier approval was withdrawn. Review the plan again before you approve it.
plan.blocked: An unfinished change has to be recovered first, so planning is paused.

apply.intro: This is the last step. Approving tells Setup it may write exactly the plan shown above, and nothing else.
apply.files_one: {{count}} file will be written to the mod.
apply.files_other: {{count}} files will be written to the mod.
apply.alreadyApproved: This exact plan is already approved.
apply.reviewedHint: Tick the box to enable the button.
apply.button: Approve and apply this exact plan
apply.planChanged: The plan changed since you reviewed it. The new plan is shown above and nothing was applied. Review it again before you approve.
apply.blocked: An unfinished change has to be recovered first, so applying is paused.
apply.nothing: The plan has no files to write, so there is nothing to apply.

result.unplannedTitle: Changes that were not in the plan
result.unplanned_one: {{count}} path changed that the plan did not list. Check it before you rely on the result.
result.unplanned_other: {{count}} paths changed that the plan did not list. Check them before you rely on the result.
result.needs_rollback: Setup stopped part way and cannot safely continue from there. Recover the change first; the recovery section is above.
result.interrupted: The apply was interrupted before it finished. Recover the change first; the recovery section is above.
result.failed: Applying the plan failed and nothing is marked as done. Scan again to see where things stand.

recovery.title: An earlier change was not finished
recovery.intro: A previous apply stopped part way. Your mod may be half changed until this is dealt with.
recovery.ownerActive: Setup still seems to be running on the server. Wait for it to finish, then reload this page, before you take any action.
recovery.manual: Setup cannot decide this safely on its own, so it offers no automatic action. A person has to review the mod and the journal by hand.
recovery.actionIntro: The one action that is safe here:

action.discard_staging: Discard the unfinished temporary files. Your mod stays as it is.
action.resume: Resume the apply and finish it.
action.rollback: Roll back: put the mod's files back the way they were before the apply.

confirm.resume: Resume and finish the interrupted apply?
confirm.rollback: Roll back the interrupted change? The files go back to how they were before the apply.

recovery.exact: The files are exactly as they were before the apply.
recovery.notExact: The files are not exactly as they were before. These differences remain:

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.emptyBody: Create a task below to give the agent a job on this mod.
tasks.spentUnknown: Some spend is not known yet and is counted at its reserved amount.
tasks.objectiveHint: Describe the job in plain words.
tasks.modeReadOnly: Read only: the agent looks at the mod and reports back
tasks.modeEdit: Edit: the agent may change files
tasks.editNote: Edits go only to the task's own branch, never to your main mod files. You review them before anything is merged.
tasks.allowedPathsHint: One folder or file per line, relative to the mod, for example common/national_focus. The agent can change nothing else.
tasks.budgetHint: The task stops when it has used this much.
tasks.modelsUnavailable: No models are available on this server yet.
tasks.needObjective: Describe what the agent should do.
tasks.needBudget: Enter a budget above zero, for example 0.20.
tasks.needPaths: Enter at least one allowed path for an edit task.
tasks.pausedNote: This task is paused{{reason}}. No new attempt can start until you resume it.
tasks.conflict: Someone else changed this task, so it was reloaded. Check the state and try again.

attemptStates.interrupt_requested: Stop requested: the agent has not confirmed that it stopped
attemptStates.reconciling: Checking what the agent did before stopping
attemptStates.unknown_effect: Stopped with an unknown effect: a tool action may or may not have happened

tasks.pendingBody: The agent started these actions, but the server does not know whether they finished. They must be checked before a new attempt can start, so that nothing is done twice or lost.
tasks.eventsPolling: Live updates are not available, so the log is checked every few seconds.
